sources.title: GGUF & GGML Formats Guide | AI Wiki
sources.snippet: GGUF (GPT-Generated Unified Format) is a binary file format designed for storing LLM models for efficient inference with GGML-based executors like llama.cpp. It succeeded the older GGML format by offering better extensibility, single-file deployment, built-in quantization support, and a key-value metadata structure that ensures compatibility across different tools and platforms.

sources.title: GGUF Model Format Explained: Supported Engines and Models
sources.snippet: GGUF is the model file format built for the C/C++ inference engine llama.cpp and the ggml library underneath it. It stores the weights (tensors) together with the metadata a runtime needs — architecture, tokenizer, chat template — in a single file.
